map.半衰期计算器依据 t½=ln2/λ 由衰变常数求半衰期，输入 λ 输出半衰期，适: The half-life calculator uses t1/2 = ln2/lambda to get the half-life from the decay constant; enter lambda and it outputs the half-life, for parameter conversion and exercises in radioactive decay models.
map.由衰变常数求半衰期。: Find the half-life from the decay constant.
map.th = ln2/λ 由衰变常数反推半衰期。: th = ln2/lambda back-calculates the half-life from the decay constant.
map.已知 λ 求特征时间。: Find the characteristic time from a known lambda.
map.：th = 0.693147 / 1.21e-4 ≈ 5.73×10³ 年 ≈: : th = 0.693147 / 1.21e-4, about 5.73 x 10^3 years, about 5730 years (C-14).
map.：若 λ=1.21e-3，则 th≈573 年，寿命缩短十倍。: : If lambda = 1.21e-3, th is about 573 years and the lifetime shortens tenfold.
map.由质量数求核半径: Find nuclear radius from mass number
map.不是直接倒数，而是 th=ln2/λ，差一个 ln2 系数。: Not a direct reciprocal; rather th = ln2/lambda, differing by an ln2 factor.
map.λ 用 yr⁻¹ 则 th 为年，用 s⁻¹ 则 th 为秒，须匹配。: If lambda is in yr^-1 then th is in years, if in s^-1 then th is in seconds; the units must match.
